description: This file defines a Smarty plugin function 'counter' which outputs and manages a counter value within Smarty templates. It handles initializing, updating, and optionally printing or assigning the counter value based on passed parameters. The function supports multiple counters distinguished by name, with configurable start, skip, and direction settings.

methods.name: smarty_function_counter
methods.description: Main function implementing the Smarty {counter} plugin. Manages internal counter state, updates, and output based on parameters.
